history.summary: Cassia View is a 72-unit freehold condo (2001) at Guillemard Rd, D14, 560m from Dakota MRT — 3BR 1,205 sqft at $1.949M / $1,617 psf, just below the $1,650 median. Freehold, sub-$2M quantum near MRT and a high ~6.3% URA rate are appealing, though the rate rests on only 14 transactions.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, $1.949M (in the liquid band), $1,617 psf below the $1,650 median, and 560m from Dakota MRT (Circle Line) is a strong combination. URA resale CAGR is ~6.3% — encouraging, though the 14-txn base means treat as indicative, not certain. At 72 units it has modest but real en-bloc optionality (appears on en-bloc-potential lists) given freehold status and age. D14/Paya Lebar Central transformation supports demand. A solid value-buy; I trim the rate for the thin sample.
red_flags: URA rate ~6.3% rests on only 14 transactions — indicative, not statistically firm
2001 build — older property, higher maintenance and some resale age discount
72-unit development — moderate, not deep, liquidity; en-bloc is optionality not a plan
catalysts: Freehold below district median PSF, $1.949M in the liquid band
Paya Lebar Central commercial transformation lifts D14 demand
Freehold + 2001 age gives genuine en-bloc optionality (72 units)

history.summary: A 72-unit freehold boutique (2001) near Dakota MRT asking $1,617 psf — exactly the last transacted print (Aug 2025: 1,206 sqft @ $1.95M / $1,618 psf, possibly the same unit re-listed) and only ~1% below the trailing 12-month average of ~$1,633 psf. No verified mispricing, plain RCR baseline exposure (+3.1%/yr forward), and very thin liquidity (14 txns/5yr, no print in ~10 months).
history.rating_rationale: The 2026-06-08 Buy rested on signals backtested to zero: freehold (level premium, no forward edge), 6.3% trailing CAGR on 14 txns (no forward power), and a ~2% sub-median PSF (noise). Verified via SRX/99.co/EdgeProp: last print Aug 2025 at $1,618 psf for 1,206 sqft — the ask matches it to the dollar, so there is no cheap-vs-district-peers edge, the one robust signal. Paya Lebar airbase redevelopment begins 2030+ (MINDEF), beyond a 5-7yr hold; PLQ uplift is already priced. What remains is fair-priced RCR exposure with boutique-block exit risk — Neutral. Medium confidence: facts well verified, but <10% of forward variance is explainable.
red_flags: Ask equals the last transacted print (Aug 2025) — zero discount; possibly the same unit re-listed at its purchase price
No transaction since Aug 2025; 14 URA txns in 5yr across 72 units — thin, slow exit
2001 build (25 yrs) — rising maintenance, dated stock vs nearby new launches
Geylang-fringe address still discounts some buyer pools
catalysts: Paya Lebar airbase 800ha redevelopment — but from 2030 or beyond, outside the hold horizon
Freehold 72-unit site retains long-run en-bloc optionality (optionality, not a plan)
